content.text: Section 18 fully meets the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18.1 obliges Vendor, at its own expense for the term plus one year, to carry CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability USD 1M, E&O USD 2M and cyber/privacy USD 5M — matching the playbook's preferred limits in full. Section 18.2 adds reputable insurers, primary status, certificates of insurance on request, notice of cancellation, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liability, which is favourable to us. No deviation; nothing to redline.
